prompt:

Keep Image 1's camera position, framing, walls, windows, doorways and furniture, traced in outline; only add the people.
Image 1: the location Sebastian's apartment, living room, the front view, with no people
Image 2: the character sheet of Sebastian (30), look S2
Image 3: the character sheet of Natalie (25), look S1
Draw each person as a clean outline figure that can be told apart by hairstyle, build and the shape of their outfit, from their character sheet; no faces in detail. Do not copy a sheet's layout, white background or multiple views. Each person appears once, whole and at natural scale for the place, on the furniture and floor of Image 1, facing the way the start says.
Only two people appear: Sebastian and Natalie. Nobody else is there.
At the start: Natalie is inside the bedroom with her bag, behind the half-closed bedroom door on the back wall. Sebastian, in his tuxedo, stands at the kitchenette end of the couch. The white pillow lies at the front-door end of the couch; the signed agreement and the blue pen lie on the round coffee table.

No shading, solid black areas, colour or photographic rendering: dark hair and clothes are outlines left white inside; no text, letters, numbers, arrows, labels or watermark.
